title: EquinoxxMC
body:
# EquinoxxMC 3
The third iteration of the EquinoxxMC series intended to offer a Vanilla+ experience

## Key features
- Survival Multiplayer
- Create Mod (plus Create Add-ons)
- Corpses
- Vanilla Worldgen

## Modpack
This server is intended to be used by a minecraft instance with the [EquinoxxMC modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/equinoxxmc) installed.
_Recommended launchers to play are Prism Launcher or the Modrinth App._

## How to join
Join the chat [here](https://matrix.to/#/#equinoxxmc3:equinoxx.dev) and ask to be whitelisted, ensure to provide your username.
